title: 南京新街口真实OSM几何数据（演示地图用）
source: OpenStreetMap main API, four small bbox map extracts
height_policy: Use explicit OSM height tags where present, otherwise estimate levels*3m, otherwise a labelled building-type default (usually 12m). Footprints are actual OSM geometries. Estimated heights are illustrative, not surveyed. Retain height_source and height_estimated on every building.
notes: Coverage reflects community mapping; missing features are not invented.
Polygon footprints are retained whole, so boundary buildings and long roads may extend slightly beyond the requested bbox.
No carbon values are included; overlay demonstration values must be labelled separately.
Retain the visible attribution and distribute this metadata with the derived GeoJSON.
Raw extract cache is in scripts/osm-cache and need not be shipped with the website.
